LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
FL-8101: the storage and loading flare, one of four flares on the site's 122 m vapour flare derrick
(warm/wet, cold/dry, storage and loading, spare); derrick and liquid burner are site scope (S-02, D-001, D-017).
T-8101 / T-8102: LNG spill sumps, tank-area troughs / platform (D-018); kept dry, pumps in floor pockets (D-039).
T-8101: I-801, I-809, I-810. LZT-8105 (independent of LIC-8101): I-802 at high-high starts both pumps
P-8101A/B (whichever is not running) and closes LV-7102; non-latching, it yields to I-803.
FL-8001 also receives BOG-4013 (carrier de-inerting and cool-down vapour, P-04) and FL-7003
(BOG compressor depressurising vents, P-07). FO-8107: minimum-flow orifice of P-8101A/B.
T-8102 kept dry: P-8103 (drive on the cover), I-806 / I-807 on LZT-8106, I-808 lockout on TSL-8104 / 8118 (1oo2);
LAH transfer hold, LAHH I-805 (LZT-8119). FL-8101 pilot ignition (flame-front generator) and re-ignition on pilot
failure (TI-8131) are part of the site's flare derrick package (S-02).
HV-8106A/B, HV-8108A/B: suction and discharge isolation of P-8101A/B for maintenance.
I-803 at low-low stops P-8101A/B (D-026.14). HS-8101A/B: motor control.
HV-8106A/B: cryogenic ball valves, cavity vented to the drum side; CV-8102A/B have a
pressure-equalising hole in the disc, so a pump blocked in between HV-8106x and
HV-8108x relieves into D-8101; drain the pump to the drum first (D-026.14, D-028).
PZT-8123A/B/C: instrument-air header low-low, 2oo3, see C&E I-804 (ESD-1 of both berths, rundown trip).
B-SUB AHU-1 outdoor-air intake LV1 (layout/hvac.yaml): gas trip
AT-8141A/B/C 2oo3, C&E I-811: AHU-1 stopped (UZ-8144), UZ-8142 / UZ-8143 closed.
